claim_boundary: This record authorizes continued repository and local-model development on the current native Windows host and Ubuntu WSL guest. It does not waive, pass, narrow, or replace any governing requirement or required final OS certification evidence.

deferrals.scope: two independent physical A1 reference boards
deferrals.reason: Only one physical laptop is available. Native Windows and its Ubuntu WSL guest are two software environments on the same machine.
deferrals.required_evidence: Complete firmware/device inventories and the governed offline workflow, failure, pressure, recovery, and performance suite on both boards.

deferrals.scope: Ubuntu 24.04 reproducible baseline and Ubuntu migration lab
deferrals.reason: The current Ubuntu environment is a 26.04 LTS WSL2 guest, not a native 24.04 baseline or migration lab.
required_environment: E8 matched 24.04/26.04 images on both A1 boards and one server
deferrals.required_evidence: Pinned image/package provenance, repeatable construction, native boot, Secure Boot, upgrade, data migration, rollback, and compatibility results.

deferrals.scope: destructive installation, boot, storage, power-loss, and recovery fixtures
deferrals.reason: No separately identified disposable disks or firmware-key recovery fixture is available in the current environment.
deferrals.required_evidence: Installation target safety, signed UKI/A-B boot, dm-verity, LUKS2 recovery, interrupted update, rollback, power-loss, and model-independent recovery results.

deferrals.reason: The Admin governance and delegation design is implemented for development, but protected production key storage and human custody are external operational controls.
required_environment: separated lab and production trust roots
deferrals.required_evidence: Named custodians, Admin assignments, bootstrap/recovery, rotation/revocation, key-role separation, signing ceremony, verification exercise, and proof that model-visible processes cannot access private keys.

deferrals.scope: signed 4–6B compact control model and governed candidate comparison
deferrals.reason: Qwen3-1.7B is intentionally selected only as a low-resource development smoke baseline and is below the governed parameter range.
deferrals.required_evidence: Legally approved signed packs for at least two 4–6B candidates and one mainstream candidate, exact runtime tuples, offline workflow results, quality adjudication, load/context/pressure/cancellation/recovery measurements, and redistribution decisions.

deferrals.scope: complete security, failure-injection, manual, and performance qualification
deferrals.reason: Repository tests and bounded smoke runs cannot exercise all hardware, confinement, key-custody, boot, lifecycle, thermal, or sustained-load conditions.
deferrals.required_evidence: The governing security and manual test suites plus Q01, Q02, Q06–Q08 distributions, negative results, raw artifacts, independent review, and disposition of every severity 0/1 defect.

deferrals.scope: real 400–405B placement/load and later execution qualification
deferrals.reason: The current 16 GiB laptop and 4 GiB RTX 3050 do not provide suitable capacity; legal model assets and a large-model host are not available.
deferrals.required_evidence: The G1 governed real placement/load result or measured blocking constraint, followed by the full G6 execution suite before any large-model product claim. Sparse mappings and fake tensors are not successful model execution.

deferrals.reason: Native Windows and WSL are current development lanes, but the required Windows broker, identity mapping, confinement, WSL product packaging, VM, dual-boot, encrypted storage, and recovery labs are not established.
deferrals.required_evidence: Applicable W/QW and inherited A1 tests on exact retained Windows, WSL, driver, filesystem, encryption, and accelerator tuples.

change_control.rule: Adding a 450B target or treating any deferral as a pass requires a controlled requirements revision and updated test, environment, capacity, license, and safety evidence.
